name: Pyplan
description:
Pyplan is a platform for building and running Planning & Analytics applications across Finance, Sales, Operations, and HR. This connector lets Claude work directly with your Pyplan workspace: list the applications you have access to, open a specific app, read results from its model nodes (tables, cubes, KPIs), run the tools exposed inside the app to execute simulations and scenarios, and manage app versions. Authentication uses OAuth against your Pyplan tenant, so Claude only sees the apps, companies, and departments your user is already permitted to access — all role, team, and department-level permissions configured in Pyplan are respected.
Key features: discovery and opening of Pyplan applications across your workspaces (My Apps, Public Apps, Team apps); execution of any tool exposed by an app's author (P&L generation, balance sheet and cash flow views, what-if simulations, forecast updates, etc.); structured retrieval of node results for analysis and visualization in chat; creation and saving of new application versions so scenario work is preserved alongside the baseline; and a domain-skill loader that gives Claude the right context for each Pyplan area before it acts.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Pyplan to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Pyplan to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://dev.pyplan.com/ai/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Pyplan MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Pyplan provides these MCP tools: call_tool, close_application, create_app_version, get_skill, list_app_versions, list_applications, open_application, save_application, and save_as_new_app_version.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Pyplan?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Pyplan in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.
Pyplan requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Pyplan is developed by Pyplan. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
